function.name: updateBreak
function.description: This function updates the label of a break node within an abstract syntax tree. node.description: The break node to be updated. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

Here’s how you can do it:

```json
{
  "node": "<your-node-as-a-string>",
  "label": "loopEnd"
}
```

Replace `<your-node-as-a-string>` with the actual stringified representation of your break node (e.g., `"{\"type\":\"BreakStatement\",\"label\":{\"type\":\"Identifier\",\"name\":\"oldLabel\"}}"`). Once you provide that, I can call the `updateBreak` function for you.
